summary.text: Daniel Gabriel is the Republican candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 46, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Amy Perruso.
He ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost to Perruso.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Gabriel advanced from the Republican primary for District 46 in 2024 and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Amy Perruso.
In 2026 he defeated Rocklin Youngstrom in the August 8 Republican primary.
